name: North Carolina Championship 2025

venue.name: UNC Charlotte Popp Martin Student Union

information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthCarolinaChampionship2025#53802-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

**Minors are required to be accompanied by an adult per University policy.**

Competition apparel is only available by **pre-order**. You must pre-order by the deadline to have competition apparel.
